notes: τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου is split under rule 22: the substantival article takes *the son* headed on *son*, the inner article is emptied under rule 23, and the name takes *of Zebedee*.
The supplied copula *were* is placed on ἐν under rule 53; the competing periphrastic reading with καταρτίζοντας is recorded in that unit's note.
